autoContext: You are a telegram bot server.

_setup.purpose: The Telegram control channel fails closed. It will not start until a bot token and at least one numeric user/chat allowlist are present in the process environment.
instructions: Create the bot with Telegram's @BotFather and export its token: export TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN='123456:token'
Before starting this workflow, send /start to the new bot in Telegram.
With the bot workflow stopped, inspect the update using: curl -fsSL "https://api.telegram.org/bot${TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN}/getUpdates"
In result.message, copy from.id for your user ID and chat.id for the chat ID. A private chat ID is normally positive; a group/supergroup chat ID is normally negative.
Authorize specific people with a comma- or space-separated list: export TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_USERS='123456789'
Or authorize specific chats: export TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_CHATS='-1001234567890'
You may set both variables. When both are set, the incoming sender ID and chat ID must both be listed.

Run this workflow from the same environment: clay run system messaging telegram. If clayd itself is launched as a persistent service and must read these variables, configure them in that service environment before restarting it.
Never commit the bot token to this workflow, config.json, or any other repository file.
